Hints: A negative exponent gives a reciprocal.|16^(1/2)=4.
Solution: Take the reciprocal because the exponent is negative: (16)^(-1/2)=1/[(16)^(1/2)]. The positive power is (4)^1=4, so the result is 1/4. The base is positive and nonzero.
